description: The first-letter-vowel resolver driven with terms whose first character is unusual: empty, whitespace, digit, punctuation, uppercase, precomposed versus decomposed accents, a byte-order mark, a control character and an astral emoji. The resolver inspects charAt(0) against 'aeiouAEIOU', so each term pins a different assumption a port might make about normalization, trimming, or code-point iteration.
